result.summary: The home feed renders correctly, but the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the content shown.

issues.description: The bottom navigation marks 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) while the screen content is the home delivery feed (delivery address, search, category chips, and restaurant lists). The selected tab does not match the visible screen.
issues.suggestion: Highlight 'Home' when the home feed is displayed, and only show the Profile state as active when the profile screen is actually shown.
